destinationGuide.title: Discover On Board & Destinations
destinationGuide.bannerText: 2 nights at sea and 5 hours to explore beautiful Oslo
destinationGuide.osloText: Stroll across the iconic marble roof of the Oslo Opera House and enjoy views over the fjord, the Munch Museum and Barcode.
destinationGuide.foodText: Our talented chefs work their magic with fresh fish, succulent meat, Nordic cheeses and delicious desserts in 7 Seas and Explorers Steakhouse.
destinationGuide.shopText: Shop for perfume, cosmetics, Scandinavian sweets, spirits and brand-name goods at 20–40% below high-street prices.
destinationGuide.skiTitle: Ski Holidays in the Norwegian Mountains
destinationGuide.skiText: Bring your car to Norefjell, Hemsedal, Hafjell or Trysil. Arrive in Oslo at 10:00, relaxed and well rested.
